Task: Silicon bulk minimisation for Surface Energy - Level 1

Report the total energy of the relaxed structure in eV, and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.

{"BULK ENERGY": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"BULK ENERGY": "56.00", "path to relaxed structure": "/structure/structure.dat"}
